summary:
Estonia will close all its border crossings with Russia from 1 December, its foreign minister said on Sunday, after a suspected sabotage attack on an Estonian drone maker that Tallinn blamed on Moscow. Authorities say Russian intelligence ordered the attack, which Estonia's prime minister linked to Tallinn's support for Ukraine.

China's foreign ministry said on Monday that Xi Jinping, Donald Trump and Vladimir Putin will hold their first trilateral summit in Shenzhen on Thursday, to discuss 'safeguarding world peace and promoting strategic stability'. Ukraine, Iran and denuclearisation could also come up, but Beijing has not given details of the agenda. Iran has launched drone attacks on a US military base in Bahrain, its second strike on Bahrain in days after a two-month lull, casting further doubt on peace talks with Washington.

Houthi forces were advancing on Aden, the interim seat of Yemen's internationally recognised government, on Sunday and were 60 kilometres from the city, according to military sources. Saudi-backed forces said they were moving troops from the Bab al-Mandab Strait to protect Aden. In Spain, nearly 2,200 migrants reached the Canary Islands over two days, the coastguard said on Sunday, though another report put the figure at around 2,000.

headlines.title: Estonia to close all Russian border crossings from December 1
headlines.summary: Estonia will close all its border crossings with Russia from 1 December, its foreign minister said on Sunday, after a suspected sabotage attack on a drone maker. Authorities say Russian intelligence ordered the attack, which the prime minister linked to Tallinn's support for Ukraine.

headlines.title: China says Xi, Trump and Putin will hold summit in Shenzhen
headlines.summary: China's foreign ministry said on Monday that Xi Jinping, Donald Trump and Vladimir Putin will hold their first trilateral summit in Shenzhen on Thursday. Beijing has not given details of the agenda, though Ukraine, Iran and denuclearisation could feature.

headlines.title: Iran launches drone attacks on US base in Bahrain
headlines.summary: Iran has launched drone attacks on a US military base in Bahrain, its second attack on Bahrain in days after a two-month lull. The strikes cast further doubt on peace talks between Tehran and Washington.

headlines.title: Houthis advance within 60 kilometres of Yemen's interim capital Aden
headlines.summary: Houthi forces were advancing on Aden on Sunday and were 60 kilometres from the city, according to military sources. Saudi-backed forces said they were moving troops from the Bab al-Mandab Strait to protect Aden, leaving the strait under Houthi control.

headlines.title: Nearly 2,200 migrants reach Canary Islands in two days
headlines.summary: Spain's coastguard said on Sunday that nearly 2,200 migrants had reached the Canary Islands over two days, though another report put the figure at around 2,000. Authorities had declared a migration emergency earlier in the week.

headlines.title: Ukraine strikes bridge linking Russia to Crimea
headlines.summary: Ukraine struck the bridge linking Russia and Crimea across the Kerch Strait, limiting traffic, Crimea's Russian-backed governor Sergei Aksyonov said on Monday. The strike appeared to cause only minor damage but drew an angry response from the Kremlin.

headlines.title: Five EU countries expected to announce Rwanda deportation hub
headlines.summary: Germany, Denmark, Austria, Greece and the Netherlands are expected to announce a 'return hub' for failed asylum seekers in Rwanda on Monday. It would be the first such facility outside the EU.
